xpbd.mechanism: Position and velocity receive separately rounded incremental corrections; velocities below1e-4 are snapped tozero. Default reconstruction from full position delta is disabled.
xpbd.limitation: The frozen8eps position/velocity criterion was an engineering check, not a derived forward-error bound for100 iterative projections. Invalid records are not proof of state injection. Allsix moving cases also exceed the independent1e-7Ns momentum guard; both observations are retained.

kamino.mechanism: Quaternion exponential update multiplies the old quaternion without an explicit renormalization in this function.
kamino.limitation: Observed norm drift exceeds the frozen8eps check in several cases. Source-linked numerical observation, not a hardware/material accuracy claim; no renormalization is inserted into acquisition or acceptance.

vbd.mechanism: Primal/dual alternation precedes final force query; velocities are reconstructed fromFP32pose differences. The no-contact negative also fails the original momentum guard.
vbd.limitation: Matched-prefix and fixed-input probes quantify the observed behavior. They do not uniquely separate every roundoff/contact-solve contribution.

score_scope: All frozen decisions remain. Supplementary raw measurements and normalized-quaternion geometric diagnostics do not award acceptance. A source-derived precision-aware protocol would require a new prospective freeze and heldout validation.
